name: Solid American Walnut Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid American walnut slats in a deep chocolate brown, sealed with three coats of low-satin polyurethane and backed with 9mm black acoustic felt.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates and rounded inch labels: 8 square-cut solid walnut slats, 27 mm (1.063 in) faces plus 10.5 mm (0.413 in) black felt gaps on 37.5 mm (1.476 in) pitch, 13 mm wood over 9 mm felt, 22 mm total depth. Tile spans eight pitches by 600 mm; main.jpg supplies deep chocolate walnut face tones for the three-coat low-satin polyurethane finish, with procedural vertically wrapping grain.
